[[File:Tommy EP034.png|thumb|200px|Tommy]] '''Tommy''' (Japanese: '''タロウ''' ''Tarō''), also known as '''Tomo''' (Japanese: '''ターサン''' ''Tarsan''), is a little boy who lives in [[Safari Land]] and was raised by {{p|Kangaskhan}}. ==In animation== Tommy is the [[character of the day]] in ''[[EP034|The Kangaskhan Kid]]''. {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} were traveling through [[Safari Land]] when {{TRT}} tried to steal a herd of Kangaskhan living on a preserve area of the park. A feral boy freed the captured Kangaskhan with his boomerang, and led them in action against Team Rocket. Later, a rich couple arrived in a helicopter and explained they were looking for their son Tommy who had been missing for five years. The family was flying over the Safari Zone when the father held their child outside the window of the copter to give him a better look and dropped him. The couple showed [[Officer Jenny]] a picture of their boy, and she recognized him as Tomo - the feral boy who protects the Kangaskhan. Brock tried to help an injured baby Kangaskhan and Tommy attacked Brock with his boomerang. Tommy's human {{TP|Tommy|parents}} tried to explain who they are, but Tommy insisted that the Kangaskhan have always been his real parents. Tommy's father knocked him unconscious and the boy remembered his past. Team Rocket tried to steal the Kangaskhan again with a giant robot, but Tommy's parents crashed their helicopter into the robot to destroy it. Tommy's parents emerged from the rubble, however, and announced that they planned to live in the Safari Zone with Tommy and the Kangaskhan herd. ===Pokémon=== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} ====Befriended==== This is a list of {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} Tommy has befriended in {{aniseries|OS}}. {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Tommy |pkmn=Kangaskhan |type1=Normal |gender=female |img=Safari Land Kangaskhan.png |epnum=EP034 |epname=The Kangaskhan Kid |vajp=Sachiko Kobayashi |desc=Tommy's {{p|Kangaskhan}} is a Pokémon Tommy befriended. Her only appearance was in ''[[EP034|The Kangaskhan Kid]]'', and she is the biggest one of her herd. She first appeared when {{TRT}} caught a herd of Kangaskhan, including Tommy's, with their huge net, but they were eventually saved by Tommy and she rode off with Tommy in her pouch. {{Ash}} and [[Ash's friends|his friends]] find the baby Kangaskhan which is supposed to be in the pouch where Tommy is and heal it. Later Team Rocket turn up in their new [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]] and tranquillize all of the Kangaskhan except for the leader. With the help of Ash and his friends they send Team Rocket blasting off. In the end Tommy, [[Tommy's parents|his parents]] and the baby Kangaskhan live with each over with the Kangaskhan herd. Kangaskhan's only known move is {{m|Dizzy Punch}}.}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=くまいもとこ ''[[Motoko Kumai]]'' |en=[[Carter Cathcart|Jimmy Zoppi]] |ar=فدوى سليمان ''Fadwa Souleimane'' |fi=Minna Tasanto |cs=Inka Šecová |de=Hubertus von Lerchenfeld |no=Erik Skøld |pt_br=Fábio Villalonga |es_eu=Cristina Yuste |es_la=Humberto Ramírez |pl=Renata Berger{{tt|*|Original dub}}
Maksymilian Michasiów{{tt|*|Redub}} |nl=Huub Dikstaal}} ==In the manga== ===The Electric Tale of Pikachu=== [[File:Tommy EToP.png|thumb|220px|Tommy in the manga]] Tommy appears in ''[[ET07|Pikachu's Excellent Adventure]]'', where he helps a lost {{AP|Pikachu}}, along with {{p|Squirtle}} and {{p|Charmander}}, find the [[Hidden Village]] where Pikachu hopes to be reunited with {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|EToP|Ash}}. Tommy lives with his adoptive mother, a {{p|Kangaskhan}}. His biological parents are never shown in the manga. It is unknown when he was separated from his parents. Kangaskhan believes that he has been abandoned. Tommy is able to speak fluently in Pokémon language as well as basic human language. ====Pokémon==== =====Befriended===== This is a list of {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} Tommy has befriended in the Electric Tale of Pikachu. {{anchor|Kangaskhan 2}}{{TrainerPoké |trainer=Tommy |pkmn=Kangaskhan |width=72 |type1=Normal |gender=female |img=Kangaskhan EToP.png |epnum=ET07 |epname=Pikachu's Excellent Adventure |desc={{p|Kangaskhan}} is a Pokémon Tommy befriended and considers his mother. She and Tommy took Pikachu, {{p|Squirtle}}, and {{p|Charmander}} to the Pokémon Paradise in the Hidden Village. When Team Rocket attacked the Village and started capturing the Pokémon there, she and Pikachu defeated them and sent them blasting off. Kangaskhan's only known move is {{m|Mega Kick}}.}} ==Trivia== * Tommy is a fairly obvious parody of {{wp|Tarzan}} in both his back story and behavior, as well as his Japanese name. ** In an old Pokémon.com summary, he was called '''Tarzan''', which comes from his Japanese name.[http://web.archive.org/web/19991012181211/http://pokemon.com/cartoons/fourthten.html Pokémon World - Cartoons] (archive) ==References== ==Related articles== {{Electric Tale of Pikachu characters}} {{Project COD notice}} [[Category:Kanto characters of the day]] [[Category:Animation characters]] [[Category:Electric Tale of Pikachu characters]] [[Category:Male characters]] [[de:Tommy]] [[es:Tommy (Kanto)]] [[it:Tommy (GA034)]] [[zh:达山]]
